Corporate.name: CEO Dashboard
Corporate.intent: Strategic Command Center: Top-level Aura HUD followed by a global KPI grid. Lower sections include region performance heatmaps and strategic goal progress trackers.

Corporate.name: COO Dashboard
Corporate.intent: Operations Command: Aura HUD with operational telemetry. Main dashboard features efficiency metrics across branches and a real-time service quality log.

Corporate.name: CFO Dashboard
Corporate.intent: Financial Oversight Hub: Aura HUD with cash liquidity telemetry. Tier 1 includes burn rate analytics and capital allocation visualization for enterprise planning.

Corporate.name: Compliance Manager Dashboard
Corporate.intent: Compliance Command: Aura HUD with integrity monitoring. Features an anomaly heatmap for identifying procedural drift and execution gate logs for auditability.

Corporate.name: Finance Director Dashboard
Corporate.intent: Finance Operations: Aura HUD with real-time cash flow telemetry. Dashboard provides a summary of receivables/payables and budget distribution analytics.

Corporate.name: Training Director Dashboard
Corporate.intent: LMS Governance Portal: Aura HUD integrated with a certification compliance heatmap. Middle tier handles active enrollment telemetry, with the footer reserved for predictive competency drift analysis.

Clinical.name: Clinical Director Dashboard
Clinical.intent: Clinical Oversight Hub: Top-tier Aura HUD followed by a safety telemetry grid. Main body contains staffing optimization heatmaps and protocol compliance audits.

Clinical.name: Quality Metrics Portal
Clinical.intent: Clinical Governance Engine: Aura HUD with sentinel event telemetry. Layout prioritizes outcome variance visualization and rigorous best-practice audit checklists.

Clinical.name: Nurse (RN) Dashboard
Clinical.intent: Advanced Care Console: Aura HUD with critical vitals telemetry. Main interface is dominated by the Medication Administration Record (MAR) and wound care assessment modules.

Clinical.name: PSW Dashboard
Clinical.intent: Field Care Portal: Aura HUD with high-visibility patient summary cards. Actionable checklist for daily care tasks, with a dedicated floating quick-report action for incident tracking.

Clinical.name: Social Worker Dashboard
Clinical.intent: Social Care Command: Aura HUD with community resource telemetry. Dashboard centers on psychosocial observation logs and a real-time crisis response grid.

Clinical.name: Oncology Specialized Care View
Clinical.intent: Specialized Clinical Portal: Patient-centric Oncology care plan management and specialized vitals tracking.

Clinical.name: Gerontology Specialized Care View
Clinical.intent: Specialized Clinical Portal: Patient-centric Gerontology care plan management and specialized vitals tracking.

Clinical.name: Pediatrics Specialized Care View
Clinical.intent: Specialized Clinical Portal: Patient-centric Pediatrics care plan management and specialized vitals tracking.

Clinical.name: Palliative Specialized Care View
Clinical.intent: Specialized Clinical Portal: Patient-centric Palliative care plan management and specialized vitals tracking.

Clinical.name: Rehabilitation Specialized Care View
Clinical.intent: Specialized Clinical Portal: Patient-centric Rehabilitation care plan management and specialized vitals tracking.

Clinical.name: Memory Care Specialized Care View
Clinical.intent: Specialized Clinical Portal: Patient-centric Memory Care care plan management and specialized vitals tracking.

Franchise.name: Franchise Owner Dashboard
Franchise.intent: Local Business Command: Aura HUD for real-time alerts. Top section features a business KPI grid (revenue, staff count). Middle section focuses on staff oversight.

Franchise.name: Operations Manager Dashboard
Franchise.intent: Logistics Command Center: Aura HUD with supply chain telemetry. Main layout features a resource allocation map for coordinating field staff.

Franchise.name: Scheduler Dashboard
Franchise.intent: Coordination Hub: Aura HUD with real-time shift coverage telemetry. Centered around a master coordination calendar with a sidebar for urgent remediation.

Franchise.name: Billing Admin Dashboard
Franchise.intent: Revenue Recovery Console: Aura HUD with AR (Accounts Receivable) telemetry. Primary focus on the pending claims ledger and automated collection status.
